meaning: Holds the value passed to the producer in ecx

meaning: Holds the vtable 0x81d7c0

meaning: Holds the allocated length of the slot array

name: m_slotCount
meaning: Holds the number of slots; ids at or past it are refused

name: m_slots
meaning: Holds the property pointer for each id

name: m_listLinkOffset
meaning: Holds 4, the offset of the link inside a listed property

name: m_listHead
meaning: Holds the update list head, linked to itself when empty

meaning: Holds the eye position

name: m_targetProperty

meaning: Holds the far clip distance

name: m_nearClipProperty
meaning: Holds the near clip distance property, id 3, a scalar

name: m_nearClip
meaning: Holds the near clip distance

meaning: Holds the pitch angle

meaning: Holds the cosine of the pitch angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_pitchSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the pitch angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_fovProperty
meaning: Holds the field of view property, id 4, a angle

name: m_fov
meaning: Holds the field of view

name: m_fovCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the field of view, recomputed on every store

name: m_fovSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the field of view, recomputed on every store

name: m_rollProperty
meaning: Holds the roll angle property, id 5, a angle

name: m_roll
meaning: Holds the roll angle

name: m_rollCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the roll angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_rollSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the roll angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_yawProperty
meaning: Holds the yaw angle property, id 6, a angle

name: m_yaw
meaning: Holds the yaw angle

name: m_yawCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the yaw angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_yawSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the yaw angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_createTime
meaning: Holds the client clock when the object was built

name: m_held
meaning: Holds the held command bits; 0x1 and 0x2 are the two primary mouse commands

name: m_travelX
meaning: Holds the sum of scaled |dx| since the first primary press

name: m_travelY
meaning: Holds the sum of scaled |dy| since the first primary press

name: m_motionStamp
meaning: Holds a graphics device counter read at the last mouse motion while a command was held

name: m_pressTime
meaning: Holds the clock time of the first primary press

name: m_clickMode
meaning: Holds the armed click action, 1 or 2, set to 0 when a release is a drag

name: m_link
meaning: Holds a list link, zeroed by the constructor and unlinked by 0x7c5950

name: m_transportLink
meaning: Holds the transport passenger link; linked when its second dword is not 0

name: m_position
meaning: Holds the live position, in transport space while a transport GUID is set

name: m_facing
meaning: Holds the live facing, recomputed from the anchor facing each substep

name: m_pitch
meaning: Holds the live pitch, recomputed from the anchor pitch and clamped to ±π/2

name: m_upVector
meaning: Holds the up vector: (0, 0, 1) at construction, the averaged contact normal after a resolve, rolled by a bank

name: m_owner
meaning: Holds a pointer to the owner's GUID, passed to the movement notifications

name: m_transportGuid
meaning: Holds the transport GUID; 0 makes the transport transforms the identity

name: m_moveFlags
meaning: Holds the movement flags: direction 0xf, turn 0x30, pitch 0xc0, walk 0x100, falling 0x2000, swim 0x00200000

name: m_anchorPosition
meaning: Holds the position the displacement is measured from, copied from +0x10 by 0x7c5cd0

name: m_anchorFacing
meaning: Holds the facing the turn integrates from, copied from +0x1c by 0x7c5cd0

name: m_anchorPitch
meaning: Holds the pitch the pitch integrates from, copied from +0x20 by 0x7c5cd0

name: m_anchorElapsed
meaning: Holds the milliseconds since the anchors, zeroed by 0x7c5cd0 and added to before each dispatch

name: m_direction
meaning: Holds the unit travel direction the straight displacement uses

name: m_headingBasis
meaning: Holds the horizontal travel axis: cos and sin of the anchor facing, turned for strafe

name: m_pitchBasis
meaning: Holds cos and sin of the anchor pitch while swimming, else 1 and 0

name: m_fallTime
meaning: Holds the milliseconds elapsed on the fall arc, zeroed when an arc starts

name: m_fallStartZ
meaning: Holds the arc start height; the body is D(t) below it

name: m_stepBaseZ
meaning: Holds the z a step-up probe started from, the base of the climb limit

name: m_currentSpeed
meaning: Holds the current speed, stored by 0x7c5c20

name: m_walkSpeed
meaning: Holds the walk speed

name: m_runSpeed
meaning: Holds the run speed

name: m_runBackSpeed
meaning: Holds the backward run speed

name: m_swimSpeed
meaning: Holds the swim speed

name: m_swimBackSpeed
meaning: Holds the backward swim speed

name: m_turnRate
meaning: Holds the turn rate in radians per second, also the pitch rate

name: m_fallStartSpeed
meaning: Holds the arc launch speed, down-positive: a jump stores -7.955547

name: m_spline
meaning: Holds the 0x70-byte spline record 0x630c40 allocates, or null

name: m_lastFireTime
meaning: Holds the fire time of the last status, seeded with the event time of the first

name: m_lastSenderStamp
meaning: Holds the last sender time stamp, kept only on a forward step and advanced by a skip

name: m_collisionRadius
meaning: Holds half the model width times the scale (0x6174b0); 1/3 at construction

name: m_collisionHeight
meaning: Holds the model height times the scale (0x6174b0); 2.0277777 at construction

name: m_scaleRatio
meaning: Holds the scale over the display scale, or 1.0 when that is below 2^-22; 1.0 at construction

name: m_latenessRing
meaning: Holds the last 32 lateness samples 0x618b50 stores, in ms; sixteen -50 then sixteen 50 at construction

name: m_latenessCursor
meaning: Holds the ring slot 0x618b50 writes next, advanced modulo 32

name: m_latenessBase
meaning: Holds the ring maximum 0x618c30 stores at each re-base, added to each new sample; 50 at construction

name: m_facingRate
meaning: Holds the facing rate in radians per second toward the queue head, from 0x618f80

name: m_facingRateTime
meaning: Holds the seconds to the queue head over which +0x144 applies; 0 turns the rate off

name: m_correctionTime
meaning: Holds the ms to the queue head at arming, read as int32, the divisor of the position blend; 0 when off

name: m_events
meaning: Holds the event queue header: link offset, last link, then the first CPlayerMoveEvent

name: m_unit
meaning: Holds the unit that owns the mover, the constructor's fourth argument

name: m_linkPrev
meaning: Holds the link to the previous node of the list the event is in

name: m_linkNext
meaning: Holds the next node, or the list's own link with bit 0 set at the end

name: m_time
meaning: Holds the time the event takes effect, the queue's sort key, compared as a signed difference

name: m_tag
meaning: Holds the internal tag, 0 to 38, that the two consumer switches map to an action and opcode

name: m_position
meaning: Holds the event position, transport-local when the snapshot has a transport

name: m_facing
meaning: Holds the event facing, transport-local when the snapshot has a transport

name: m_pitch
meaning: Holds the event pitch

name: m_transportGuid
meaning: Holds the snapshot's transport GUID, 0 off a transport

name: m_moveFlags
meaning: Holds the snapshot's movement flags masked with 0x75a07dff

name: m_fallTime
meaning: Holds the snapshot's fall time, the status field 0x7c6340 copies from CMovement+0x78

name: m_value
meaning: Holds the new speed for tags 20 to 25, or the first knockback direction component

name: m_directionY
meaning: Holds the second knockback direction component

name: m_speedXY
meaning: Holds the knockback horizontal speed

name: m_speedZ
meaning: Holds the knockback vertical speed, stored into CMovement+0xa0 by 0x7c61f0

name: m_counter
meaning: Holds the server change counter that the acknowledgement echoes

name: m_hasStatus
meaning: Holds 1 when 0x617730 filled the snapshot fields, 0 from allocation

name: m_send
meaning: Holds 1 when processing the event sends its opcode to the server

name: m_statusDone
meaning: Holds 1 once the current operation's status is set

name: m_statusResult
meaning: Holds the status's result flag, 1 for success

name: m_operation
meaning: Holds the operation the status belongs to

name: m_statusCode
meaning: Holds the status code, an index into the 83 status names

name: __vfptr
meaning: Holds the vtable 0x801364

name: m_tableLink
meaning: Holds the context's link in its context table bucket

name: m_handle
meaning: Holds the context's handle, its key in the context table

name: m_lock
meaning: Holds the critical section guarding the run state, messages and timers

name: m_runState
meaning: Holds 0 running, 1 closing, 2 torn down

name: m_heapNode
meaning: Holds the heap node: vtable 0x801368, owning heap and index

name: m_dueTime
meaning: Holds the clock time the context is next due, the heap key

name: m_lastFrameTime
meaning: Holds the clock time of the last frame time or start dispatch

name: m_flags
meaning: Holds 1 started, 2 interactive, 4 after-frame pending

name: m_idleTime
meaning: Holds the idle time in milliseconds, at least 1

name: m_idleTimeInitial
meaning: Holds the idle time as constructed; a difference from +0x48 overrides the timer wait

name: m_cost
meaning: Holds the load the context adds to its slot: 1000 interactive, 1 otherwise

name: m_costTarget
meaning: Holds the cost passed to the reschedule

name: m_costChanged
meaning: Holds 1 when the cost moved by more than an eighth

name: m_handlerLists
meaning: Holds the 29 handler list heads of 12 bytes, one per category

name: m_messages
meaning: Holds the deferred message list head

name: m_heldButtons
meaning: Holds the held-button mask the dispatch keeps

name: m_heldKeys
meaning: Holds the held-key list head

name: m_timerTable
meaning: Holds the array of timer records by id

name: m_freeTimerIds
meaning: Holds the array of timer ids free for reuse

name: m_timerHeap
meaning: Holds the heap of timers ordered by due time

name: m_link
meaning: Holds the record's link in its category list

name: m_handler
meaning: Holds the function, called as fastcall(payload, argument)

name: m_argument
meaning: Holds the argument passed in edx

name: m_priority
meaning: Holds the priority; higher runs first

name: m_skip
meaning: Holds nonzero for a record the dispatch and registration pass over

name: m_logPath
meaning: Holds the movement log path copied by 0x616860

name: m_logFile
meaning: Holds a log file handle, closed by 0x7c4e90 and 0x616910

name: m_fallLogFile
meaning: Holds a second log file handle, closed by 0x616910

name: m_movers
meaning: Holds the list of movers with work pending: link offset 0, then the terminator link

name: m_flags
meaning: Holds bit 0 once 0x616860 has initialised the manager

name: m_lastTickTime
meaning: Holds the clock at the last tick, written by 0x616860 and 0x616800

name: m_stepTime
meaning: Holds the end of the step being simulated, written per step by 0x616620

name: m_heartbeatDeadline
meaning: Holds the time of the active mover's next heartbeat, set by 0x615b80 and moved by 0x615ae0

name: m_type
meaning: Holds the event type, 0x12 to 0x16

name: m_time
meaning: Holds the client clock when the node was queued

name: m_data
meaning: Holds the node's own copy of the packet bytes

name: m_length
meaning: Holds the length of the copied bytes

name: m_accumulator
meaning: Holds the sum the advance returns; the seed after seeding

name: m_lanes
meaning: Holds four lane indices, byte k a byte offset into the table

name: m_state
meaning: Holds the socket state: 5 connected, 6 closed, 7 closing

name: m_recvBuffer
meaning: Holds the receive buffer

name: m_recvFill
meaning: Holds the count of bytes in the receive buffer

name: m_recvCapacity
meaning: Holds the receive buffer's size, grown by 1024

name: m_cipherArmed
meaning: Holds 1 while the header cipher is armed

name: m_sendIndex
meaning: Holds the send key index, 0 to 39

name: m_sendFeedback
meaning: Holds the last ciphertext byte sent

name: m_sendSpan
meaning: Holds the bytes after the size header that are ciphered on send, 4

name: m_recvIndex
meaning: Holds the receive key index, 0 to 39

name: m_recvFeedback
meaning: Holds the last ciphertext byte received

name: m_recvSpan
meaning: Holds the bytes after the size header that are deciphered on receive, 2

name: m_keyLength
meaning: Holds the key length, 40

name: m_key
meaning: Holds the key, the NetClient's 40 bytes at +0x48
